featured_reviews.name: Amogha J
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Whimsical Twist on Nostalgia! 🍫🍧
Walking into Bombay Sweet Shop feels like stepping into a dessert paradise where traditional Indian flavors meet fun, modern updates. We dropped by for a massive tasting session and were completely hooked. On the savory side, the Avo Papdi Chaat and the vibrant Mango Burrata Papdi Chaat were incredible, creamy upgrades to classic street food. For desserts, the absolute highlight of the day was the Rasgulla Tiramisu. It’s a masterclass in fusion that blends velvety mascarpone with soft, syrupy rasgullas. The Coconut Chilli Mango Sundae was another winner; it had a super unique texture and a really creative mix of spicy, sweet, and tropical flavors that you just don't find anywhere else.
The drink game here is also top-tier. We sampled everything from a Vietnamese Cold Coffee and an Old School Cold Coffee to a customized Veronica’s Cold Coffee (which they perfectly made without their usual date syrup). We also tried their beautiful Iced Matcha Mango Latte with a touch of vanilla, which had a fantastic flavor balance. A huge bonus was the retail counter, where they let us try a bunch of house-made chocolates and snack mixes. I totally fell in love with the Tom Yum Makhana Mix. It’s a super unique, tangy, and zingy spin on a classic snack. This place is a must-visit!

Definitely catch their seasonal mango specials before they run out!

featured_reviews.review_text: The cafe itself.is slightlyntucked away from the lames of Kala Ghoda. The staff are friendly and helpful. The food is absolutely delicious. The Onion Kachori in Kadhi is the best dish I've had. Their menu is creatively designed and changes with the seasons. Their cold coffees, Kachori, Mango Milkshake and Mango Kalakand Cheesecake are must try!

featured_reviews.review_text:
As a graphic designer, the first thing that caught my attention was the packaging. Every detail feels thoughtfully designed, and it's easily some of the best branding and presentation I've seen in the food space.

The service was equally impressive. The staff was empathetic, kind, and genuinely hospitable, making the entire experience feel warm and welcoming.

Now, the food. The fusions here are absolutely insane in the best way possible. I tried the Chole Bhature Hummus Platter and wow. what a burst of flavours. It's one of those dishes that sounds unusual on paper but works brilliantly. I also tried the Rajma Galauti, which was delicious and packed with flavour.

Bombay Sweet Shop does an incredible job of reimagining familiar Indian flavours in exciting new ways. Between the food, the service, and the beautiful presentation, it's a place I'd happily come back to again and again.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bombay Sweet Shop – A Modern Take on Traditional Indian Sweets

Bombay Sweet Shop beautifully reimagines Indian mithai with a contemporary twist, both in presentation and flavours. The packaging is premium and festive, making it an excellent choice for gifting—especially during Diwali or special occasions. What stands out is the innovation: classic sweets are thoughtfully reinvented with modern textures, balanced sweetness, and high-quality ingredients.

The variety is impressive, ranging from fusion mithai boxes to snackable treats like barks and savoury options. Each item feels well-crafted and fresh, with consistent quality across products. The store itself is vibrant and inviting, and the staff is helpful when it comes to explaining the concept and recommending combinations.

Pricing is on the higher side compared to traditional sweet shops, but the creativity, hygiene, and overall experience justify it. If you’re looking for something unique that still respects Indian flavours, Bombay Sweet Shop is definitely worth a visit—great for self-indulgence and even better for premium gifting.

featured_reviews.name: Ankur Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s easily one of my absolute favourites in Mumbai! ❤️

From desserts and chocolates to their food and seasonal specials—everything here just hits right. And their coffee? Truly top-notch.

My personal must-tries:
1.	Gymkhana Cold Coffee Softy with Nut Brittle (pro tip: always ask for extra brittle 😉)
2.	Baked Bhatura with Pindi Chole Hummus – those cherry tomatoes, onions & hung curd dip on the side are chef’s kiss 🤌
3.	Veronicas Cold Coffee with oat milk, date syrup & espresso shots – super smooth and perfectly balanced
4.	Fusion Gulab Jamun Churros with Vanilla Dip – and trust me, order a separate pistachio dip… this combo is next level 🤯
5.	Seasonal Desserts – Peach Matcha Cake, Strawberry Tres Leches & more

Honestly, once you try it, it might just become your go-to spot too!

✨ Heads up: Seating is very limited, so be prepared for a short wait or opt for takeaway—totally worth it though!

They also have a great range of souvenirs and healthier options—gluten-free treats, their in-house chikkis (makhana & kurmura), and Indian farsan like bhujia.

✨ Seasonal specials are worth trying too—Ponkh Bhel with Hara Bhara Falafel and Baked Bhatura with Saag Burrata are absolute standouts.

And don’t leave without trying their choco fudge with peanut chikki—it’s to die for! 😍
